# [TASK] Retrofit parent/child linkage across the whole board

## Task
Retrofit the whole board so every Epic, Story and Task declares its parent and lists its children back, and mirror that hierarchy into GitHub's native sub-issue graph so the project board renders it.

## Scope
Structural linkage only. Acceptance-criteria state and Notes prose are #247's and this Story's other Tasks' problem, not this one's.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Every Story and Task declares a parent in a `## Parent Epic` / `## Parent Story` section, or states in writing why it deliberately has none
- [x] Every parent lists its children back, each entry carrying a short label rather than a bare `#N`
- [x] Markdown parents and native GitHub sub-issue links agree for every issue, with no one-way edges
- [x] Child checkboxes match the children's real open/closed state
- [x] Process-doc links resolve to the right file on the current repository name

## Estimate
**Hours:** 3

## Notes

52 issue bodies rewritten and 124 native sub-issue links created. Re-audited against a fresh fetch afterwards: 0 problems across all 187 issues — no missing parents, no one-way edges, no bare child references, no checkbox drift, no stale repository URLs. Native parent links went 35 to 159; all 12 Epics now roll up on the board.

#177, #234 and #227 keep a written "no parent Story" rationale instead of a link. That is a recorded decision, left intact.
